suppressions.candidate: A stale session could retain access after a staff account is deactivated or its role changes.
suppressions.note: requireStaff resolves the session only as an account identifier, then reads id, email, role, and ativo from admin_users for every protected operation. Missing or inactive accounts are rejected before capability dispatch.

suppressions.candidate: The Secretariat application list could deliver financial or applicant-evidence data through a broad query.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria branch uses explicit application and student column allowlists at the database query boundary before data reaches the client.

suppressions.candidate: The restricted donor list could expose CPF, address, CEP, or receipt metadata.
suppressions.note: The Secretaria donor query selects operational fields only and omits CPF, address, CEP, receipt path, and receipt name at the database boundary.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat caller could obtain an applicant-evidence ticket by submitting a known storage path.
suppressions.note: getDocumentUrl uses requireAuth, whose only implementation delegates to requireAdmin; Secretariat final-document access is limited to the separate persisted-ID action. The legacy path action also rejects the issued-document namespace.

suppressions.candidate: A Secretariat user could download an old final-document version or a contract for a rejected application by guessing an ID.
suppressions.note: The action resolves the ID server-side and, for Secretaria, compares it to the role-aware current-document query. That query excludes all pending documents and contracts for rejected applications, and returns only the latest version per kind.

suppressions.candidate: An anonymous caller could mint an upload ticket with traversal, arbitrary category, or dot-segment path.
suppressions.note: Categories are a fixed allowlist plus tightly indexed student patterns; filenames are sanitized and reject dot segments; each signed path is server-generated below a fresh pending/{uuid} namespace. Storage independently enforces root containment.

suppressions.candidate: Observation body may execute markup supplied by Secretariat.
suppressions.note: The reviewed renderer places the body in a React text node and has no dangerouslySetInnerHTML use, so supplied markup is escaped rather than executed.

suppressions.candidate: A download ticket is not bound to an active session when redeemed.
suppressions.note: The TechSpec retains a ticket-only delivery endpoint and places authorization before ticket issuance; tickets are HMAC-signed, scoped, and expire after 300 seconds.
